subject: POC plan & final readout scheduling — Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + proposed POC plan (next steps)

Hi Tom/Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Success criteria (as discussed):
   - End-to-end response latency under 300ms p50 for interactive assistant flows (90% of traffic)
   - Cost per 1k tokens below $0.60 after batching & caching optimizations
   - No regression on the clinical hallucination test set (ACME-eval v1) — target F1 >= 0.92

2) POC scope & timeline (proposed):
   - Week 1 (Jun 21–25): Integration & sample data ingest (Marcus/engineering access)
   - Week 2 (Jun 28–Jul 2): Performance tuning + evaluation runs
   - Week 3 (Jul 5–9): Final readout and decision (exec-level; 30–45m)

3) Ownership:
   - Redwood SE/Integration: Marcus Lin (setup, access, perf tuning)
   - Customer POC lead: Tom Alvarez (data, evaluation okrs)
   - Customer exec sponsor: Priya Singh (final decision)
   - Redwood CS: Neha Kapoor (enablement & success criteria obs)

4) Ask from Acme before we start:
   - Sample anonymized dataset (5–10 representative threads / records)
   - Network allowlist for rdp/ssh to dev infra (IP ranges to be provided)
   - Confirm final readout attendee list (exec + engineering)

Attached: redwood-poc-mop.pdf (MOP + runbook) and acme-eval-template.xlsx (eval metrics template).

Proposing we lock a 30–45m final readout week of Jul 5 — available windows: Tue Jul 6 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu Jul 8 14:00–15:00 PT. If you prefer an earlier decision, we can target Jun 29–30 for a light readout.

Thanks — I can kick off the access requests once you share the sample data.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-1224

Subject: Re: Recap + proposed POC plan (next steps)

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Success criteria look right; add one operational constraint: PII must not leave our VPC during the POC (we will provide anonymized samples but need to validate the line of sight).
- We can provide a 7–10 record sample set by EOD Jun 22; I'll have legal confirm the anonymization checklist.
- Final readout: Priya and I prefer an earlier decision if possible — Jun 29 would be ideal (Priya has travel the week of Jul 5).

Marcus — can you confirm the exact network allowlist IPs and if we need to open any specific ports?

I'll confirm the attendee list (Priya + myself + 1 eng lead). Thanks — Tom

Tom Alvarez
Director of Product, Integrations | Acme Health
tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmehealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed POC plan (next steps)

Thanks Tom — understood on the PII constraint. Two quick notes: 

1) We can run in a private deployment mode for the POC (customer-managed VPC peering) so no data leaves your environment — Marcus will outline the steps.
2) We'll aim to accelerate the cadence so Jun 28–29 works. Proposed updated timeline: 
   - Jun 22–24: sample ingest + allowlist validation
   - Jun 25–27: initial perf runs
   - Jun 28–29: evaluation runs + light readout (30m)

Marcus: can you take point on the VPC peering checklist & IPs? Neha will set up the evaluation sheet and monitoring dashboards so Priya can see the metrics in real time during the readout.

If Jun 29 is confirmed, we should lock a 30m slot — morning PT preferred. We'll plan the exec-level decision to be go/no-go based on the three success criteria in the MOP.

—Marissa

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-23T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Recap + proposed POC plan (next steps)

Tom — quick technical note and checklist items from our side: 

- IP allowlist: please open outbound to 34.83.21.145/32 and 34.83.21.146/32 for the short-lived setup tunnel; we use port TCP 443 only. If you'd rather we initiate an inbound tunnel, we can provide a temporary bastion host — happy to follow whichever is easier for your infra team.
- For VPC peering: we'll need an IAM service account and an S3 bucket role (if you prefer S3 transfer) OR SFTP credentials. Which does your infra prefer?
- Data format: JSONL with fields: id, text, metadata.clinical_tag. If you can send 5–10 samples, we'll validate ingestion within 24 hours.
- Test harness: we'll run a 3k-token synthetic batch and a set of 200 representative calls for latency profiling. Expect ~1 business day for initial perf numbers after ingestion.

I'll create a short runbook for the infra handoff this afternoon and post it to the Drive link (shared).

—Marcus
Marcus Lin | Senior Solutions Engineer
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Recap + proposed POC plan (next steps) — scheduling final readout

Hi team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on samples, Tom. We have everything we need from your side to start. A few calendar items to lock: 

1) Final readout (30–45m) for exec decision — proposed: Tue Jun 29 09:00–09:45 PT or Tue Jun 29 11:00–11:45 PT. Please confirm a preferred slot and attendee list.
2) Decision playbook: we'll present per-MOP metrics and mark go/no-go on the three criteria (latency, cost, hallucination F1). If any criterion is borderline, we'll list mitigation steps + expected time to resolve and an ask for a 2-week extended validation.
3) Next contract step: if go, we'll prepare a term sheet and a 90-day Dedicated/Private deployment quote for procurement (I will loop in finance if you confirm intent to proceed).

Neha will send the live evaluation dashboard link and the readout slide deck a day before the meeting. Marcus will share the runbook and access summary.

Can you confirm which slot works? If Priya is traveling, we can also do a 20–30m light readout on Mon Jun 28 afternoon (PT) if that helps.

—Marissa
